data_policy: Real admin, artworks, keys and settings were not used as test data. Mutating flows ran in an isolated Compose project; the real local server and archiver were checked read-only.

isolated_stack.synthetic_pixiv: QA-only worker entry point injecting adapter_factory, download and encode into the real worker; dataset re-read on every call
isolated_stack.real_pixiv_requests: none, except loading the official login page inside the QA login browser

1_first_archive.r18_policy: metadata only, originals after allowing R-18

2_search.note_search: not a search target by design

4_duplicates_and_failures.worker_sigkill_and_redis_flushall: same job redelivered from SQLite outbox and completed

5_remote_changes: masked work shown as access unconfirmed

distinct_states: waiting_auth with automatic resume after revalidation
waiting_storage with needed and free space

artist/tag directories, alias/account/translation search, tag rename and merge preview

settings: display rating, download rating, schedule, conversion concurrency, full refresh 27 rechecks with 0 re-downloads

login browser: noVNC shows official Pixiv login, completion without login rejected
mobile 390x844: 9 screens without horizontal overflow, FAB above bottom navigation

fixes.change: catch-all landing becomes /setup right after setup
